name: Swissôtel Jakarta PIK Avenue
short_description: A 5-star Swissôtel in North Jakarta with direct access to PIK Avenue Mall and bay views, a short drive from Soekarno-Hatta Airport, holding a 4.7/5 ALL Rating (828 reviews).
ai_summary: Swissôtel Jakarta PIK Avenue is a 5-star hotel in North Jakarta's Pantai Indah Kapuk (PIK) area, with direct access to PIK Avenue Mall and sweeping bay views. It is a short drive from Soekarno-Hatta International Airport and sits in what the property describes as one of Jakarta's safest districts. Facilities include elegant rooms and suites, a Chinese restaurant, Pürovel Spa & Sport, a swimming pool, and meeting facilities. The hotel holds a 4.7/5 ALL Rating from 828 reviews on its own Accor page. Standard ALL elite benefits apply for Accor loyalty members.
